description: Use when you need a random number generator, dice rolls, a coin flip, a uuid or random bytes that no one can predict. Do not use for verifiable on-chain randomness (VRF) or reproducible seeded sequences. Returns JSON with cryptographically secure random values: integers in a range, dice rolls, coin flips, UUIDs or hex bytes, from the Workers Web Crypto CSPRNG for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 500 ms (p95). Category: Infrastructure. Price: US$0.005 per call. A small free demo credit covers the first calls; after that the tool returns the command that pays the call from your own wallet (AgentCash or Coinbase Agentic Wallet).

count.description: How many values (1-100, default 1); ignored for bytes

kind.description: integer (count values between min and max), dice (count rolls of a die with sides faces), coin (count flips), uuid (count UUID v4) or bytes (length random bytes as hex)

length.description: bytes: how many random bytes (1-256, default 32)

name: blackwood_random_generate
title: Random numbers
